# Task system design diagram

[`task-system-design.svg`](task-system-design.svg) is the editable, self-contained
source embedded in the project README and architecture guide. Edit the SVG
text, shapes, and connectors directly; no remote assets or diagram renderer are
needed to display it. It deliberately uses a generic SQL symbol because the
library does not require Amazon RDS or provision the database.

The AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS, and EventBridge Scheduler artwork is from the official
[AWS Architecture Icons](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/) package,
release 07312026. AWS icons are © Amazon Web Services, Inc.; their use is subject
to the terms supplied by AWS, separately from this project's MIT license.

Source package:
[Icon-package_07312026.zip](https://d1.awsstatic.com/onedam/marketing-channels/website/public/shared/architecture-icon-release/Icon-package_07312026.5846e92413caa21490223536cc97f1269e44fa92.zip).
Only the artwork used by the diagram is embedded in the SVG.
